CFML Language Reference: Functions

Max

Compares two numbers and returns the greater one.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

Max(number1, number2)

Parameters

number1
A number.
number2
A number.

Returns

The larger of the two numbers.

Usage

Max takes exactly two arguments. For the largest value in an array use ArrayMax; for a column of a query, let SQL do it with SELECT MAX(column). Max and Min together clamp a value into a range: Min(Max(n, 1), 10) keeps n between 1 and 10.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFPARAM NAME="URL.Page" DEFAULT="-3">
<CFSET SafePage = Min(Max(URL.Page, 1), 10)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Max(3, 7) = #Max(3, 7)#<BR>
Max(-1, -1.5) = #Max(-1, -1.5)#<BR>
Requested page #URL.Page#, clamped to 1-10: page #SafePage#
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

Min, ArrayMax, Abs
